name: 磁悬浮声波亮白电动牙刷款
description: 声波高频震动洁牙、五种清洁模式、长续航，附双刷头

styleLock.backgroundSystem: pastel studio backdrops in soft mint #CDE7DE, pale peach #F7CEBF and light blue #D7EDF2, cream off-white #FBF7F2 info panels, pure white #FFFFFF packshots and comparison panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, large front-left key with fill, gentle falloff, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: pale pink terrazzo-look pedestal #EFD9D5, clean white block risers #FFFFFF, warm off-white surface #FBF7F2, soft pink fur and slatted wall accents
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family, charcoal #3A3A38, headline 28-48pt, small oval and rounded-rectangle labels 14-18pt, large numerals in brass #C9A96A
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line icons in white circular icon slots, one brass #C9A96A accent, no filled or 3D icons
styleLock.presentationRules: product always stands upright at a stable scale, stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle, centered on a pedestal or inside a clean rounded panel, gold ring collar and round power button always readable, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft pastel oral-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream off-white #FBF7F2, soft mint #CDE7DE, pale peach #F7CEBF and one brass accent #C9A96A with charcoal text #3A3A38; neutral color temperature; bright soft studio lighting with a large front-left key, gentle falloff and soft contact shadows; pastel studio backdrops with terrazzo-look pedestals, clean white risers and rounded pastel info panels; one modern geometric sans-serif family, small oval and rounded-rectangle info labels; consistent thin-line icon style in white circular icon slots; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal pastel infographic elements; stable upright product scale and angle; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no product redesign.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规、轮廓清晰
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level front view, the device standing upright, full product visible with nothing cropped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, large front key with soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the base
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The device standing upright, straight-on eye-level front view, full product visible with nothing cropped, filling 60-70% of the square frame as a clean centered packshot. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a large front key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. Props: none. Text zone: none, the frame contains no text at all. Clean commercial electronics e-commerce quality with crisp edges. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no warped straight lines.

shots.intent: 一秒说清洁净口腔的核心利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, the product on the right side of the frame standing on a pedestal
shots.lighting: soft front-left studio key with gentle falloff, soft contact shadow
shots.background: soft mint #CDE7DE backdrop with a pale pink slatted wall accent on the right
shots.props: two pale pink terrazzo-look cylindrical pedestals, one striped mint circle panel behind the product, one small green plant sprig at the far right edge, none covering the product
shots.textZone: 左上区域一条短标题「{callout_1}」#3A3A38，下方一枚金铜描边 #C9A96A 胶囊标签「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle on the right side of the frame, standing on a pale pink terrazzo-look cylindrical pedestal, a second smaller pedestal behind it, one striped mint circle panel behind the product, a single small green plant sprig at the far right edge, none of the props covering the product, the whole composition filling 50-60% of the frame as one complete balanced layout. Soft front-left studio key with gentle falloff and a soft contact shadow. Background: soft mint #CDE7DE backdrop with a pale pink slatted wall accent. Text zone: the upper left area carries one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #3A3A38 at 40pt and one rounded pill label 「{callout_2}」 outlined in brass #C9A96A at 20pt, completing the left column of the composition. Negative: no extra text, no fake logo, no watermark, no second product, no hands, no invented oral-care claims, no cluttered props, no floating product.

shots.intent: 用图标矩阵一次讲完六大功能，降低理解成本
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, flat graphic layout
shots.lighting: even flat studio lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: rounded light-blue panel #D7EDF2 on a warm off-white #FBF7F2 page
shots.props: six white circular icon slots in two rows of three, one thin divider rule, one rounded section tag
shots.textZone: 面板内六条短标签「{callout_1}」—「{callout_6}」#3A3A38，标题区一条短标题「{selling_point_1}」，右上角小号英文副标题
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic feature grid screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat layout photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, the rounded panel and product together filling 40-50% of the frame with about 15% warm off-white #FBF7F2 panel margins around it. A large rounded light-blue panel #D7EDF2 holds six white circular icon slots in two rows of three, each slot drawn with one single-weight thin-line glyph and followed by one short label 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_6}」 in #3A3A38 at 16pt inside a rounded rectangle, plus one thin divider rule and one small rounded section tag 「{selling_point_1}」 outlined in brass #C9A96A, with a small English sub-heading at the upper right. The product is shown once, at a slight 3/4 angle beside the panel. Even flat studio lighting, no dramatic shadow. Negative: no more than six feature labels, no dense body text, no fabricated performance numbers, no filled or 3D icons, no brand marks inside the icon slots, no watermark, no fake logo, no more than one product.

shots.intent: 用低角度气势镜头讲清震动洁牙机制，强化科技感
shots.camera: photographed from a very low angle looking upward, mid shot cropping the lower handle so the brush head rises toward the upper third of the frame
shots.lighting: soft softbox light from the front-left, soft contact shadow under each unit
shots.background: pale peach #F7CEBF with a soft gradient
shots.props: one clean white block riser and one spare brush head standing on a smaller white riser at the lower right
shots.textZone: 右侧大字数字「{callout_1}」#3A3A38，下方一行说明「{callout_2}」，一枚金铜描边圆角标签「{selling_point_1}」；数字槽位由使用方在生成时填充
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce mechanism benefit shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward, mid shot cropping the lower handle so the brush head rises toward the upper third of the frame, with a second spare brush head standing on a small white riser at the lower right, main unit and spare head together filling 65-75% of the frame. Soft softbox light from the front-left with a soft contact shadow under each unit. Background: pale peach #F7CEBF with a soft gradient. Props: one white block riser and one spare brush head. Text zone: a large number slot 「{callout_1}」 in charcoal #3A3A38 at 60pt on the right with a smaller sub-line 「{callout_2}」 at 18pt and one rounded tag 「{selling_point_1}」 outlined in brass #C9A96A; the actual figures are supplied at generation time rather than invented. Negative: no hard-coded performance figures, no invented test data, no certificates, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cropped brush head, no warped handle, no floating unit.

shots.intent: 给出四色机身选择，让买家直接选颜色下单
shots.camera: photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at a flat 2x2 grid, all four units standing upright and evenly spaced
shots.lighting: bright even studio light, identical direction and intensity on all four units, soft contact shadow under each
shots.background: pale green-white #F2F7F5 with four rounded mint #D7EDF2 panels
shots.textZone: 每个色块下方一枚小椭圆标签「{callout_1}」—「{callout_4}」#3A3A38
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Four units shown standing upright and evenly spaced in a 2x2 grid, each inside its own rounded panel: warm off-white #F7F3EE, soft pink #E8A9B5, soft blue #BFD9E8 and soft red #C85B52; identical three-quarter hero angle and identical lighting across all four. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the flat grid. Bright even studio light with a soft contact shadow under each unit. Background: pale green-white #F2F7F5 with four rounded mint #D7EDF2 panels. The set occupies 60-70% of the frame overall, the grid composed edge to edge with even narrow margins so the layout reads as one complete balanced composition. Text zone: one small oval label 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_4}」 in #3A3A38 at 14pt under each unit. Negative: no mixed lighting, no color drift between panels, no more than four variants, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no missing unit, no inconsistent scale.

shots.intent: 把五种清洁模式讲清，回答怎么用与买哪种
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile, the product standing upright in the right third, mid shot showing the full handle and neck
shots.lighting: soft even studio light from the front, soft contact shadow
shots.background: vertical gradient from pale peach #F7D8CC at the top to warm off-white #F2EDE6 at the bottom
shots.textZone: 左侧五行编号清单：大号金铜数字 #C9A96A + 每条一行短标签「{callout_1}」—「{callout_5}」#3A3A38，行间细分隔线；顶部短标题「{selling_point_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic mode list screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown at a clean 90-degree side profile in the right third of the frame, standing upright with the full handle and neck visible and the round power button and brass ring collar facing the camera, product and list together filling 50-60% of the frame as one complete balanced layout. Soft even studio light from the front with a soft contact shadow. Background: vertical gradient from pale peach #F7D8CC at the top to warm off-white #F2EDE6 at the bottom. On the left, five evenly spaced numbered rows, each with a large numeral in brass #C9A96A and one short label 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_5}」 in charcoal #3A3A38 at 18pt inside rounded rectangles, separated by thin rules, with one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 above. Negative: no more than five mode labels, no dense body text, no invented mode names, no deformed button rendering, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用微距证明刷毛密度与磨圆做工，建立品质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the bristle field, shallow depth of field with foreground bristles sharp and the handle falling out of focus
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing individual bristle tips and the mounting surface
shots.props: one spare brush head resting at the lower left edge, out of focus
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the whole point
shots.textZone: 左下角一枚白色小卡片，内放一条短注解「{callout_1}」#3A3A38
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the brush head of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Tight zoom on the bristle field, shallow depth of field with the foreground bristles sharp and the handle falling out of focus, and one spare brush head lying at the lower left edge out of focus. Raking side light from the right revealing individual bristle tips and the mounting surface. Background: soft mint blue #C4E4EA. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only minimal margin around it, because the detail is the whole point. Text zone: one small white inset card in the lower left carrying a single short annotation 「{callout_1}」 in #3A3A38 at 14pt. Negative: no blurry subject, no melted or fused bristles, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no dust, no stray hairs, no second brush head in focus.

shots.intent: 用诚实的前后对比展示日常清洁差异，降低效果疑虑
shots.camera: straight on, tight crop on the lower face at mouth level, two matched panels with identical framing and camera
shots.lighting: soft even lighting, identical on both panels, no dramatic contrast
shots.background: pure white #FFFFFF panels on a soft pink-beige #EBD9D3 page with two mint #CDE7DE label bars
shots.props: two mint label bars, one small inset for the product
shots.textZone: 左面板一条标签「{callout_1}」，右面板一条标签「{callout_2}」，#3A3A38
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce honest before-and-after comparison for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two matched white #FFFFFF panels with identical framing, identical camera and identical lighting; only the state of the teeth differs, both panels composed edge to edge with tight even margins as one complete balanced layout. Photographed straight on as a tight crop on the lower face at mouth level, showing a generic adult smile with no recognizable identity. Left panel: ordinary teeth with a naturally dull surface and everyday film, labeled by one mint #CDE7DE bar 「{callout_1}」 in #3A3A38 at 18pt. Right panel: the same smile looking naturally clean after a regular brushing routine, labeled by a matching bar 「{callout_2}」. The product is shown once, small, front-facing, in the lower right corner of the right panel and occupies 25-30% of that panel. Soft even lighting. Negative: no fabricated or exaggerated whitening results, no teeth shade beyond natural, no dental procedure implication, no recognizable person or identity, no fake statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用规格与包装清单消除尺寸与到手内容的疑虑
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle product on the left third standing upright, straight-on spec list on the right, eye-level
shots.lighting: even flat studio light, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: warm off-white #FBF7F2 panel with a light grey #E6E2DC rule grid
shots.props: one small rounded inset panel at the lower right holding a close-up of the brush head bristle tips
shots.textZone: 右侧两列规格表：六个短标签「{callout_1}」—「{callout_6}」#3A3A38，每项右侧一个短值槽位，实际数值由使用方在生成时填充；下方小图注「{selling_point_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and specification screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown at a slight 3/4 angle on the left third, standing upright on a warm off-white #FBF7F2 surface, product and spec list together filling 50-60% of the frame as one complete balanced layout. On the right, a clean two-column specification list on a warm off-white #FBF7F2 panel with a light grey #E6E2DC rule grid: six short labels 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_6}」 in #3A3A38 at 16pt, each with one short value slot on its right, the actual values supplied at generation time. At the lower right, one small rounded inset panel holds a close-up of the brush head bristle tips, so the screen reads as tangible product craft rather than empty surface. Even flat studio light with no dramatic shadow. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, test data, sales counts or warranty terms; no fabricated badges, no certificates, no serial numbers, no QR codes, no dense paragraph text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以刷柄加备用刷头的组合收口促单，突出多色可选
shots.camera: group slight 3/4 view, main unit upright and centered with a second unit beside it and two spare heads on a low riser in front
shots.lighting: even soft studio light, soft contact shadows
shots.background: pale peach #F7CEBF with a clean lower band in warm off-white #FBF7F2
shots.props: one low white riser carrying two spare brush heads
shots.textZone: 一条短收口文案「{callout_1}」#3A3A38，一枚金铜底 #C9A96A 圆角按钮内放短行动文案「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Group three-quarter view: the main unit upright and centered, a second unit standing beside it and two spare brush heads arranged on a low white riser in front, suggesting a complete ready-to-use set, the group filling 55-60% of the frame in one complete balanced composition. Even soft studio light with soft contact shadows. Background: pale peach #F7CEBF with a clean lower band in warm off-white #FBF7F2. Text zone: one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in charcoal #3A3A38 at 34pt and one rounded CTA button filled in brass #C9A96A carrying a short white action line 「{callout_2}」, both centered in the lower band. Negative: no real prices, no invented discounts or countdown timers, no invented claims, no QR code, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cropped units, no floating product.

provenance.notes: 从 10 张爆款详情页切片（800x1200）提炼。已剥离原品牌字与英文品牌行、模特面部与微笑特写身份、原图中文文案与专属排版、会员二维码贴片；原图宣称的数字（震动频率、续航、模式数、充电时长）与规格一律以 「{callout_n}」/「{selling_point_n}」 槽位交由使用方填充，画面内只保留结构性信息（图标矩阵、编号清单、双列规格表、前后对比双面板）；原图认证与检测数据未采信，信任镜改为刷头做工特写与真实规格清单呈现。产品一律以 {product} 占位。
